subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: The term 'CIA triad' in information security refers to:
stem_hi: Information security में 'CIA triad' शब्द किसे कहते हैं?
explanation_en: The CIA triad = Confidentiality (only authorised access), Integrity (no unauthorised change), Availability (accessible when needed) — the three core security goals.
explanation_hi: CIA triad = Confidentiality (केवल authorised access), Integrity (बिना authorisation बदलाव नहीं), Availability (ज़रूरत पर उपलब्ध) — तीन मूल security goals।
nukta_en: CIA = Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability. AAA (authentication, authorisation, accounting) is a separate trio.
nukta_hi: CIA = Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability। AAA (authentication, authorisation, accounting) अलग trio है।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: The goal of 'Integrity' ensures that:
stem_hi: 'Integrity' का लक्ष्य सुनिश्चित करता है कि:

options.text_en: Data can be accessed only by authorised users
options.text_hi: Data can be accessed only by authorised users

options.text_en: Data is accurate and has not been modified
options.text_hi: Data is accurate and has not been modified

options.text_en: Data is always available when needed
options.text_hi: Data is always available when needed

options.text_en: Unauthorised users cannot enter the system
options.text_hi: Unauthorised users cannot enter the system

explanation_en: Integrity means data remains accurate and unaltered except by authorised people — checksums/digital signatures protect it.
explanation_hi: Integrity का अर्थ है data सही और अपरिवर्तित रहे (केवल authorised लोग ही बदलें) — इसे checksums/digital signatures सुरक्षित रखते हैं।
nukta_en: Goal map: Confidentiality = authorised access only. Integrity = no unauthorised change. Availability = always accessible.
nukta_hi: Goal map: Confidentiality = केवल authorised access। Integrity = बिना authorisation बदलाव नहीं। Availability = हमेशा उपलब्ध।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following is NOT a goal of network security?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा network security का लक्ष्य नहीं है?
explanation_en: Redundancy (duplicate links/equipment) improves fault tolerance — it is a reliability technique, not a security goal.
explanation_hi: Redundancy (duplicate links/equipment) fault tolerance बढ़ाती है — यह reliability तकनीक है, security लक्ष्य नहीं।
nukta_en: Security goals = CIA. Reliability goals = redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery.
nukta_hi: Security goals = CIA। Reliability goals = redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A modification attack violates which security goal?
stem_hi: Modification attack कौन-से security लक्ष्य का उल्लंघन करता है?
explanation_en: A modification attack changes data in transit — that breaks INTEGRITY (data is no longer accurate/unaltered).
explanation_hi: Modification attack रास्ते में data बदल देता है — यह INTEGRITY तोड़ता है (data अब सही/अपरिवर्तित नहीं)।
nukta_en: Attack→goal: Eavesdropping/Interception → Confidentiality. Modification → Integrity. DoS/Interruption → Availability. Spoofing → Authentication.
nukta_hi: Attack→goal: Eavesdropping/Interception → Confidentiality। Modification → Integrity। DoS/Interruption → Availability। Spoofing → Authentication।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following attacks violates confidentiality?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा attack confidentiality का उल्लंघन करता है?
explanation_en: Interception (eavesdropping) lets an unauthorised party READ the data — breaking confidentiality.
explanation_hi: Interception (eavesdropping) से unauthorised पक्ष data पढ़ लेता है — confidentiality टूटती है।
nukta_en: Attack map: Interception→Confidentiality, Modification→Integrity, Fabrication→Authenticity, Interruption→Availability.
nukta_hi: Attack map: Interception→Confidentiality, Modification→Integrity, Fabrication→Authenticity, Interruption→Availability।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A Denial of Service (DoS) attack violates which goal?
stem_hi: Denial of Service (DoS) attack कौन-से लक्ष्य का उल्लंघन करता है?
explanation_en: A DoS attack floods a server/network so legitimate users cannot access the service — breaking AVAILABILITY.
explanation_hi: DoS attack server/network को flood करके legitimate users को service से रोकता है — Availability टूटती है।
nukta_en: DoS = Availability attack. DDoS = distributed DoS. Smurf/ SYN-flood = DoS variants.
nukta_hi: DoS = Availability attack। DDoS = distributed DoS। Smurf/ SYN-flood = DoS variants।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A spoofing attack targets which security aspect?
stem_hi: Spoofing attack किस security पहलू को लक्षित करता है?
explanation_en: Spoofing pretends to be someone else (fake IP/MAC/email id) — it attacks AUTHENTICATION (who you claim to be).
explanation_hi: Spoofing किसी और का रूप धारण करता है (fake IP/MAC/email id) — यह AUTHENTICATION पर हमला है (आप कौन हैं)।
nukta_en: Spoofing/impersonation → Authentication. Phishing → steals credentials (auth). Sniffing → Confidentiality.
nukta_hi: Spoofing/impersonation → Authentication। Phishing → credentials चुराता है (auth)। Sniffing → Confidentiality।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following is an ACTIVE attack?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा ACTIVE attack है?
explanation_en: Modification is an active attack — the attacker CHANGES the data stream; interception/traffic analysis/eavesdropping are passive (they only observe).
explanation_hi: Modification एक active attack है — attacker data stream बदलता है; interception/traffic analysis/eavesdropping passive हैं (केवल देखते हैं)।
nukta_en: Passive = observe only (eavesdropping, traffic analysis). Active = change/disrupt (modification, fabrication, interruption/DoS).
nukta_hi: Passive = केवल देखना (eavesdropping, traffic analysis)। Active = बदलना/बाधा (modification, fabrication, interruption/DoS)।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: The primary difference between active and passive attacks is:
stem_hi: Active और passive attacks के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?

options.text_en: Active attacks change data; passive attacks do not
options.text_hi: Active attacks change data; passive attacks do not

explanation_en: Active attacks intercept AND modify/disrupt the communication; passive attacks only eavesdrop without changing anything.
explanation_hi: Active attacks संचार को intercept करके बदलते/बाधित करते हैं; passive attacks केवल सुनते हैं, कुछ नहीं बदलते।
nukta_en: Active: modification, fabrication, interruption. Passive: eavesdropping, traffic analysis. Exam one-liner: 'change vs observe'.
nukta_hi: Active: modification, fabrication, interruption। Passive: eavesdropping, traffic analysis। Exam one-liner: 'change बनाम observe'।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: In the virus life cycle, which phase actually performs the malicious activity?
stem_hi: Virus life cycle में कौन-सा phase वास्तव में malicious activity करता है?
explanation_en: The execution phase runs the payload — the actual damage (deleting files, corrupting data).
explanation_hi: Execution phase payload चलाता है — वास्तविक नुकसान (files delete करना, data खराब करना)।
nukta_en: Virus phases: Dormant (idle) → Propagation (copy) → Triggering (condition met) → Execution (payload runs).
nukta_hi: Virus phases: Dormant (idle) → Propagation (copy) → Triggering (condition met) → Execution (payload runs)।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which backup medium provides Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) functionality?
stem_hi: कौन-सा backup medium Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) functionality देता है?
explanation_en: CD-R/DVD-R optical disks are WORM — data is written once and cannot be altered, making them tamper-proof archives.
explanation_hi: CD-R/DVD-R optical disks WORM हैं — data एक बार लिखा जाता है और बदला नहीं जा सकता, इसलिए ये tamper-proof archives हैं।
nukta_en: WORM = optical write-once media (CD-R/DVD-R/BD-R). Rewritable: HDD, tape (LTO), flash, CD-RW.
nukta_hi: WORM = optical write-once media (CD-R/DVD-R/BD-R)। Rewritable: HDD, tape (LTO), flash, CD-RW।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which attack becomes possible if the SAME key is reused many times in symmetric encryption?
stem_hi: यदि symmetric encryption में एक ही key कई बार उपयोग हो, तो कौन-सा attack संभव हो जाता है?
explanation_en: With many ciphertexts under one key, an attacker can compare them with known plaintexts and deduce the key — a known-plaintext (or frequency-analysis) attack.
explanation_hi: एक key के अंतर्गत अनेक ciphertexts होने पर attacker उन्हें known plaintexts से मिलाकर key निकाल सकता है — known-plaintext (या frequency-analysis) attack।
nukta_en: One-time pads are safe ONLY with a fresh key per message. Reuse → pattern analysis. Exam favourite link: key reuse → known-plaintext.
nukta_hi: One-time pads केवल हर message पर नई key से सुरक्षित हैं। Reuse → pattern analysis। Exam favourite link: key reuse → known-plaintext।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which of the following tools is mainly used for password cracking?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा tool मुख्यतः password cracking के लिए उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: Cain and Abel is a well-known password-recovery/cracking tool (sniffing, dictionary & brute-force attacks).
explanation_hi: Cain and Abel एक प्रसिद्ध password-recovery/cracking tool है (sniffing, dictionary और brute-force attacks)।
nukta_en: Security tools: Wireshark = packet analyser, Nmap = port scanner, Cain&Abel = password cracker, Angry IP Scanner = IP scanner, Snort = IDS.
nukta_hi: Security tools: Wireshark = packet analyser, Nmap = port scanner, Cain&Abel = password cracker, Angry IP Scanner = IP scanner, Snort = IDS।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Which port and IP address scanner is most famous among users?
stem_hi: Users के बीच सबसे प्रसिद्ध port और IP address scanner कौन-सा है?
explanation_en: Angry IP Scanner is the popular free tool for scanning IP ranges and open ports.
explanation_hi: Angry IP Scanner IP ranges और open ports scan करने वाला लोकप्रिय free tool है।
nukta_en: Cain&Abel = password cracking; Angry IP = IP/port scan; Snort = IDS; Ettercap = sniffing/ARP spoofing.
nukta_hi: Cain&Abel = password cracking; Angry IP = IP/port scan; Snort = IDS; Ettercap = sniffing/ARP spoofing।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: Match the attacks with their descriptions: (a) Phishing  (b) DoS Attack  (c) Man-in-the-Middle  (d) Spoofing — (i) Flooding network traffic  (ii) Stealing user credentials  (iii) Intercepting communication  (iv) Impersonation attack
stem_hi: हमलों को उनके विवरण से मिलाइए: (a) Phishing  (b) DoS Attack  (c) Man-in-the-Middle  (d) Spoofing — (i) नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक भरना  (ii) यूज़र जानकारी चुराना  (iii) संचार में हस्तक्षेप  (iv) पहचान की नकल
explanation_en: Phishing steals credentials (ii), DoS floods traffic (i), MitM intercepts communication (iii), Spoofing is impersonation (iv).
explanation_hi: Phishing credentials चुराता है (ii), DoS traffic flood करता है (i), MitM संचार intercept करता है (iii), Spoofing impersonation है (iv)।
nukta_en: Attack one-liners: Phishing=fake emails/sites, DoS=flood, MitM=middle interception, Spoofing=fake identity.
nukta_hi: Attack one-liners: Phishing=fake emails/sites, DoS=flood, MitM=middle interception, Spoofing=fake identity।

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: A ______ does not perform any destructive action directly; it only consumes system resources to bring the system down.
stem_hi: एक ______ सीधे कोई विनाशकारी काम नहीं करता; वह सिस्टम को गिराने के लिए सिर्फ system resources खाता है.
explanation_en: A worm spreads through the network making copies of itself and eats bandwidth/memory — it does not directly destroy data.
explanation_hi: Worm अपनी प्रतियाँ बनाकर network में फैलता है और bandwidth/memory खा जाता है — सीधा डेटा नष्ट नहीं करता.
nukta_en: HTET 2024 official key (b). फ़र्क: Virus = फ़ाइल में घुसता; Worm = खुद फैलता; Trojan = छिपकर; Spyware = जासूसी.
nukta_hi: HTET 2024 official key (b). फ़र्क: Virus = फ़ाइल में घुसता; Worm = खुद फैलता; Trojan = छिपकर; Spyware = जासूसी.

subtopic: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
stem_en: 'Junk email' is also known as:
stem_hi: 'Junk email' को और क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Unwanted bulk email = Spam. It fills the inbox and is often a vehicle for fraud.
explanation_hi: अवांछित भारी-भरकम email = Spam. यह inbox भर देती है और कई बार धोखाधड़ी का ज़रिया होती है.
nukta_en: Spam = junk mail; Spoof = पहचान छिपाना; Sniffer = चोरी से सुनना.
nukta_hi: Spam = junk mail; Spoof = पहचान छिपाना; Sniffer = चोरी से सुनना.

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: The text that gets transformed using a cipher algorithm is called:
stem_hi: Cipher algorithm से जिस text को बदला जाता है उसे क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: The INPUT to the cipher is the plaintext; after transformation it becomes ciphertext.
explanation_hi: Cipher का INPUT plaintext है; बदलने के बाद वह ciphertext बनता है।
nukta_en: Cryptography flow: Plain text --(cipher + key)--> Ciphertext --(decipher + key)--> Plain text.
nukta_hi: Cryptography flow: Plain text --(cipher + key)--> Ciphertext --(decipher + key)--> Plain text।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which statement about plaintext, ciphertext and key is MOST accurate?
stem_hi: Plaintext, ciphertext और key के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सबसे सही है?

options.text_en: Plaintext is generated after decryption using a public key
options.text_hi: Plaintext is generated after decryption using a public key

options.text_en: Ciphertext is the original readable message
options.text_hi: Ciphertext is the original readable message

options.text_en: Plaintext is transformed into ciphertext using an algorithm and a key
options.text_hi: Plaintext is transformed into ciphertext using an algorithm and a key

options.text_en: Ciphertext and plaintext are always of the same length
options.text_hi: Ciphertext and plaintext are always of the same length

explanation_en: Encryption transforms plaintext into ciphertext using a cipher algorithm together with a key — this is the precise description.
explanation_hi: Encryption एक cipher algorithm और key के साथ plaintext को ciphertext में बदलता है — यही सटीक विवरण है।
nukta_en: Remember the 3 objects: plaintext (readable), ciphertext (scrambled), key (secret parameter). Encryption = f(plaintext, key).
nukta_hi: 3 objects याद रखें: plaintext (पढ़ने योग्य), ciphertext (scrambled), key (गुप्त parameter)। Encryption = f(plaintext, key)।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which of the following uses the SAME key for encryption and decryption?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा encryption और decryption के लिए एक ही key उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: Symmetric cryptography uses one shared secret key for both encryption and decryption (AES, DES, Blowfish).
explanation_hi: Symmetric cryptography encryption और decryption दोनों के लिए एक ही shared secret key उपयोग करता है (AES, DES, Blowfish)।
nukta_en: Symmetric = 1 key (fast). Asymmetric = key pair (public+private, slow). Hash = one-way digest. Signature = private-sign/public-verify.
nukta_hi: Symmetric = 1 key (तेज़)। Asymmetric = key pair (public+private, धीमा)। Hash = one-way digest। Signature = private-sign/public-verify।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which of the following uses a PAIR of keys (public and private)?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा keys की एक जोड़ी (public और private) उपयोग करता है?
explanation_en: Asymmetric (public-key) cryptography uses a mathematically linked key pair — public key to encrypt, private key to decrypt (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman).
explanation_hi: Asymmetric (public-key) cryptography गणितीय रूप से जुड़ी key pair उपयोग करता है — encrypt के लिए public key, decrypt के लिए private key (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman)।
nukta_en: Public-key examples: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC, DSA. Symmetric: DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4.
nukta_hi: Public-key examples: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC, DSA। Symmetric: DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which is FASTER in encryption and decryption?
stem_hi: Encryption और decryption में कौन-सा तेज़ है?
explanation_en: Symmetric ciphers (AES/DES) are orders of magnitude faster than asymmetric ones (RSA) — that's why bulk data uses symmetric encryption.
explanation_hi: Symmetric ciphers (AES/DES), asymmetric (RSA) से कई गुना तेज़ होते हैं — इसीलिए bulk data में symmetric encryption होती है।
nukta_en: Speed: Symmetric >> Asymmetric. Hybrid systems (TLS/PGP) use asymmetric KEYS to exchange a symmetric SESSION key.
nukta_hi: Speed: Symmetric >> Asymmetric। Hybrid systems (TLS/PGP) asymmetric KEYS से symmetric SESSION key का आदान-प्रदान करती हैं।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: What is the main disadvantage of symmetric key encryption?
stem_hi: Symmetric key encryption की मुख्य कमी क्या है?
explanation_en: Both sides must share the SAME secret key securely — key distribution over an insecure channel is the classic problem.
explanation_hi: दोनों पक्षों को एक ही secret key सुरक्षित रूप से साझा करनी होती है — insecure channel पर key distribution ही classic समस्या है।
nukta_en: Symmetric weakness = key distribution (n users → n(n-1)/2 keys). Asymmetric weakness = slow + key authenticity (certificates).
nukta_hi: Symmetric कमज़ोरी = key distribution (n users → n(n-1)/2 keys)। Asymmetric कमज़ोरी = धीमा + key authenticity (certificates)।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Public key is used to:
stem_hi: Public key का उपयोग किसके लिए होता है?
explanation_en: In public-key cryptography anyone can use the recipient's PUBLIC key to encrypt; only the recipient's PRIVATE key can decrypt.
explanation_hi: Public-key cryptography में कोई भी प्राप्तकर्ता की PUBLIC key से encrypt कर सकता है; केवल प्राप्तकर्ता की PRIVATE key से decrypt होता है।
nukta_en: Encrypt with public → decrypt with private. SIGN with private → verify with public. Exam asks both directions!
nukta_hi: Encrypt public से → decrypt private से। SIGN private से → verify public से। Exam दोनों दिशाएँ पूछता है!

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: In public-key cryptography, a message encrypted with the public key can only be decrypted by:
stem_hi: Public-key cryptography में public key से encrypt किया संदेश केवल किसके द्वारा decrypt हो सकता है?

options.text_en: The private key corresponding to that public key
options.text_hi: The private key corresponding to that public key

explanation_en: Only the matching private key of the key pair can decrypt what the public key encrypted.
explanation_hi: केवल उस key pair की मेल खाती private key ही public key से encrypt किए गए संदेश को decrypt कर सकती है।
nukta_en: Public/private are mathematically paired — like a lock (public) and its only key (private).
nukta_hi: Public/private गणितीय रूप से जुड़े हैं — एक ताला (public) और उसकी एकमात्र चाबी (private) की तरह।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which statement about symmetric and asymmetric cryptography is TRUE?
stem_hi: Symmetric और asymmetric cryptography के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?

options.text_en: Asymmetric cryptography is faster than symmetric
options.text_hi: Asymmetric cryptography is faster than symmetric

options.text_en: Symmetric cryptography requires secure key exchange
options.text_hi: Symmetric cryptography requires secure key exchange

explanation_en: Symmetric cryptography requires a SECURE key exchange between the parties — that is its defining practical challenge.
explanation_hi: Symmetric cryptography के लिए पक्षों के बीच सुरक्षित key exchange आवश्यक है — यही इसकी मुख्य व्यावहारिक चुनौती है।
nukta_en: True: symmetric needs secure key exchange. False: symmetric does not inherently authenticate; asymmetric is slower; symmetric uses ONE key.
nukta_hi: सही: symmetric को secure key exchange चाहिए। गलत: symmetric स्वयं authentication नहीं देता; asymmetric धीमा; symmetric एक key उपयोग करता है।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Data Encryption Standard (DES) is a:
stem_hi: Data Encryption Standard (DES) क्या है?
explanation_en: DES encrypts data in 64-bit blocks using a 56-bit key — a classic symmetric BLOCK cipher.
explanation_hi: DES data को 64-bit blocks में 56-bit key से encrypt करता है — एक classic symmetric BLOCK cipher।
nukta_en: DES = 64-bit block, 56-bit key (symmetric). AES = 128-bit block. RC4 = stream cipher.
nukta_hi: DES = 64-bit block, 56-bit key (symmetric)। AES = 128-bit block। RC4 = stream cipher।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: What is the key length of AES-256 encryption?
stem_hi: AES-256 encryption की key length कितनी है?
explanation_en: AES-256 uses a 256-bit key (the number in the name is the key length).
explanation_hi: AES-256 में 256-bit key उपयोग होती है (नाम में संख्या key length है)।
nukta_en: AES variants: AES-128, AES-192, AES-256 (key sizes). Block size is always 128 bits.
nukta_hi: AES variants: AES-128, AES-192, AES-256 (key sizes)। Block size हमेशा 128 bits।

subtopic: Section B — Cryptography
stem_en: Which cipher method encrypts one bit or byte at a time?
stem_hi: कौन-सी cipher method एक बार में एक bit या byte encrypt करती है?
explanation_en: A stream cipher encrypts the data one bit (or byte) at a time as a continuous stream (e.g., RC4).
